atomic_facts.fact: Patagonia, Inc. is headquartered in Ventura, California
Patagonia operates in the outdoor recreation clothing, equipment, and food retail industry
Patagonia was founded in 1973 by Yvon Chouinard
As of 2026-10-01, Patagonia's voting stock is held by the Patagonia Purpose Trust
Patagonia's nonvoting stock is held by the Holdfast Collective
The Holdfast Collective holds the majority of Patagonia's economic interest
In December 2021, the European Center for Constitutional and Human Rights filed a criminal complaint against Patagonia in a Dutch court
The criminal complaint alleged Patagonia may have been complicit in the forced labor of Uyghur Muslims in Xinjiang
No subsequent criminal charges, indictment, or conviction against Patagonia have been reported as of 2026-10-01
As of 2026-10-01, Patagonia has not been subject to any material civil judgment exceeding $10 million
Patagonia has not been subject to any major regulatory sanction and has not been barred or sanctioned by a regulator such as the FTC, EPA, or CPSC
Patagonia has not been subject to any bankruptcy or insolvency proceeding
